ideas.name: C1: Prune small interactions
ideas.description: After fitting TreeHFD, compute per-interaction residual contribution on validation data; drop interactions whose inclusion reduces Residual MSE by less than a threshold (e.g., 0.1% relative), then refit/predict with the reduced interaction_list. This removes noisy low-signal interaction columns that add approximation error without benefit, at negligible extra cost.

ideas.name: C2: Deeper variable selection
ideas.description: Set depth_variable higher than default in XGBTreeHFD.fit so variables for main effects and interactions are selected from deeper tree structure, capturing interactions the shallow default misses. Compare depth_variable values 1-3 on validation data and pick the one minimizing held-out Residual MSE; runtime scales mildly since only selection depth changes.

ideas.name: C3: Least-squares recalibration
ideas.description: After TreeHFD.predict on training data, solve a constrained least-squares problem (scipy.optimize.nnls or lstsq) that rescales main-effect and interaction columns plus intercept so their sum best matches model predictions, keeping each component a function of only its own variables. Refit coefficients on a validation split to avoid overfitting, then apply to test predictions.
